# Source list mirrors dlls/dplayx/Makefile.in upstream; keep them in sync on resync.

add_definitions(
    -D__WINESRC__
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -DCOM_NO_WINDOWS_H)

spec2def(dplayx.dll dplayx.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

add_idl_reg_objects(dplayx registry dplayx.idl)

# dplayx.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/dplayx-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(dplayx_shims OBJECT dpclassfactory.c dplay.c dplaysp.c dplayx_global.c dplayx_main.c dplayx_messages.c dplobby.c lobbysp.c name_server.c)
target_link_libraries(dplayx_shims PRIVATE wine wine_dll_register wine_dll_canunload dxguid uuid oldnames libwinmm libole32 libuser32 libadvapi32 libkernel32_vista libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module(dplayx_shims)
add_dependencies(dplayx_shims wineheaders)
set(DPLAYX_REUSED
    ${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/dll/directx/wine/dplayx/dplayx_r.o)
add_cargo_module(dplayx dplayx-cargo dplayx.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS dplayx_shims psdk dplayx_r ${DPLAYX_REUSED} uuid_sources)
